instruction: This task uses ANSYS. Maximize stiffness per unit mass for the cantilever defined in C:\Users\user\Desktop\problem_spec.json. For the steps below, open Mechanical APDL from `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`. Start from C:\Users\user\Desktop\baseline_apdl_solid_beam.db and its result file. Preserve the fixed and loaded end interfaces, 500 N distributed end load, material, outer envelope, analysis type, minimum load-path width, mesh limit, and stress limit. Material may be redistributed only inside the permitted design domain. Stiffness is defined using the area-averaged directional displacement of the loaded face. Solve the final design and save its native database as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.db and its structural result as C:\Users\user\Desktop\submission.rst.
